call_points.text: Bank is in final stages of capital raise and confirmed it will not raise equity below book value.
NIM expected to widen across Q3 and Q4 supported by floating-rate loan repricing and reduced carry cost of surplus liquidity.
Management expects full-year ROE to exceed guided 13.5% even after including dilution from new capital.
Gold loans will be capped at 25% of total assets, up from current level of 23%.
Cost to average assets held below 2.5% at 2.47%, and cost-to-income ratio stood at 59.64%.
Targeting Return on Assets (ROA) of 1% or above in the near term.

operating_notes.text: GNPA and NNPA reached seven-year end lows at 2.45% and 0.89% respectively as of March 31, 2026.
DCB Bank passed postal ballot resolutions for director appointments and Articles of Association amendments, with Suhail Amin Nathani's appointment passing via SEBI Regulation 25(2A).
Bank raised $194 million via FCNR(B) window in August 2026, creating short-term liquidity carry costs in Q2.
Headcount reached 12,002 employees, with year-end total now anticipated at around 12,800 to 12,900 instead of 13,000.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹1,907.27 Cr (+9.5% YoY), net profit ₹205.65 Cr (+16.1% YoY).
DCB Bank reported Q4 FY26 standalone net profit of ₹206 Cr with GNPA improving to 2.45%.
DCB Bank Limited shared the audio recording of its April 24, 2026, earnings conference call on its website.
On April 30, 2026, DCB Bank filed the Q4 FY26 earnings call transcript reporting record annual profit of ₹732 Cr and 7-year low GNPA of 2.45%.
On May 8, 2026, DCB Bank disclosed the postal ballot voting results where all resolutions, including director appointments and AoA amendments, were passed.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): interest earned ₹2,050.43 Cr (+12.5% YoY), net profit ₹236.39 Cr (+28.5% YoY).
DCB Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹236 Cr; with Gross NPA improving to 2.29%.
On October 23, 2026, DCB Bank released its Q2FY27 investor presentation showcasing a 28.5% YoY rise in net profit to ₹236 Cr.
Audio recording of earnings conference call held on October 23, 2026 made available on DCB Bank website.
DCB Bank released Q2FY27 concall transcript, guiding for NIM expansion in H2 and stating capital raise negotiations are nearing closure above book value.

status_history.evidence: GNPA ratio improved to 2.45% as of March 31, 2026.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for dividend and fund raising

watchlist.response: Attributed to carrying excess liquidity post August FCNR(B) deposit inflows of $194M, with margins expected to expand in Q3 and Q4 as repo rate hikes pass through to floating-rate loans.
watchlist.text: Sequential NIM compression despite drop in cost of funds

watchlist.response: Acknowledged impact but noted bank has previously weathered larger earnings headwinds (MFI losses, treasury shifts) through other operational levers.
watchlist.text: Potential impact of proposed bancassurance draft guidelines reducing fee income
